violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee failed to wash his hands before putting on new gloves
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. Employee properly washed his hands before putting on clean gloves.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Wine glasses stored upside down in a bar rack with fruit flies observed landing on and around the glassware.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Remove all affected glassware from the rack; wash, rinse, and sanitize before reuse. Implement an approved pest control program to eliminate fruit flies. Store clean glassware in a location free from pest activity and contamination risk.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Litter
violations.observation: Observed an accumulation of litter on the premises. Observed piles of dirty dishes, utensils, and food containers left in the dishmachine area for more than 4 hours before cleaning. Evidence of fruit flies and buildup of food debris observed around the area.
violations.corrective_action: Remove all litter from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. Increase dishwashing frequency, add a mid-shift cleaning schedule to prevent accumulation. Do not wait until the end of the day to clean dishes; warewashing must occur continuously throughout the day.
